title: Groupe Gagneraud
description: gagneraud.fr Gagneraud French construction group founded in 1880 in Paris by mason Jean Gagneraud and his sons, now run by the sixth generation under president Jean-Francis Gagneraud and CEO Eric Delamotte. It is the only ETI sized family group in French construction, organized as a network of around 50 autonomous regional companies across five regions, Normandy, Brittany, North, Paris and PACA. With 3k employees and revenue of about 700 million euro it covers public works, building, materials, recycling, energy and industrial engineering through flagship firms Gagneraud Construction, MARC SA, Cathelain and CG2i. The group is expanding beyond traditional BTP, buying solar and EV charging brand Fulgura, recycler SECAB, and in late 2025 the industrial engineering arms of Teams Ingénierie. Its energy transition includes Brittany's largest solar plant at Bruz with 38k panels, 300 EV charging points and 75k tonnes of recycled materials a year. 554 mill euro in 2020 to 717 mil in 2025.
